description.zh:
专属集群ID。
> 参数**InstanceId**与**DedicatedClusterId**，两者必须传入其一。
description.en:
The ID of the dedicated cluster.
> Either **InstanceId** or **DedicatedClusterId** must be specified.

description.zh:
集群实例ID。
> 参数**InstanceId**与**DedicatedClusterId**，两者必须传入其一。
description.en:
The instance ID of the cluster.
> Either the **InstanceId** or **DedicatedClusterId** parameter must be specified.
The region in which the DTS instance resides.

descriptions.zh: 目前仅支持修改超配比。
descriptions.en: Currently, only the overcommit ratio can be modified.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dts modify-dedicated-cluster --instance-id rm-bp1162kryivb80000 --dedicated-cluster-id dtscluster_h3fl1cs217sx952 --dedicated-cluster-name dtscluster_test_001 --oversold-ratio 150 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-group-id rg-acfmzawhxxc0000 --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dts ModifyDedicatedCluster --region cn-hangzhou --DedicatedClusterId dtscluster_h3fl1cs217sx952 --OversoldRatio 150 --ResourceGroupId 'rg-acfmzawhxxc0000' --InstanceId 'rm-bp1162kryivb80000' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --DedicatedClusterName dtscluster_test_001
